How to use

Attach the spinning reel securely to your fishing rod. Use the reel to cast your fishing line smoothly by rotating the handle. Adjust the drag system to control the tension when reeling in fish. After use, rinse the reel with fresh water to remove any debris or salt, and dry thoroughly before storage.

Care instructions

Clean the reel regularly with fresh water to prevent salt and dirt buildup. Avoid exposing the reel to harsh chemicals or extreme temperatures. Lubricate moving parts periodically to maintain smooth operation. Store the reel in a dry place away from direct sunlight when not in use.
